classification.rationale: A men's knitted pullover falls in heading 6110 by GRI 1. The subheading depends on the chief-weight fiber: hemp is an 'other textile material', so if hemp predominates the garment goes to 6110.90.90, and with cotton under 50% it is not subject to cotton restraints, giving the men's 'other' line 6110.90.90.88 (838). NY J89828 (in force) placed a men's silk/cotton knit pullover of other textile material in 6110.90.9088, supporting the suffix. Because fiber percentages are not given, the code is a best guess.
